QUOTE: The one built-in allocator is `library/memory_buffer_alloc.c`. `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init(buf, len)` (line 566) serves allocations from a caller-supplied buffer. As a side effect it calls `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free()` to install its own functions.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer names the buffer allocator's init function as calling the runtime setter to install its own functions. It calls this the "one built-in allocator" rather than the only in-tree user of the setter, but that is close enough to the item's substance.
